rules.levels: Exact requested nonnegative level must exist; apply stored list order until first entry.level > requested. Negative selects first entry only.
rules.optionals: Read IsDefined first; undefined placeholder never replaces constructor/default/inherited value. Defined 0 and false are valid assignments.
rules.numeric_assign: _ConvertEnemyAttributes -> ReadAttributesField(Single) -> WriteAttributesField; numeric ints therefore lose precision above 2^24.
rules.integer_write: FP.AsFloat/Single -> double Round ties-to-even -> CVTTSD2SI signed int32; invalid masked conversion returns INT_MIN.
rules.FP_reset: All 34 numeric fields -> ReadAttributesField Single -> FP.from_float32 -> AttributeMeta range clamp. This is raw/cached Reset data, not dynamic CalculateAttributeValue.
rules.blackboard: For each incoming key, remove all equal-key pairs, append numeric when valueStr null/empty otherwise string; numeric ctor clears valueStr, string ctor sets value=0.
rules.skills: Match prefabKey; replace and append incoming whole skill. If existing skill and incoming Blackboard nonempty: clone incoming skill, clone existing Blackboard then ApplyBlackboardData(incoming).
rules.sp: Non-null incoming spData replaces the whole reference/data.
rules.field_alias: EnemyDatabase.EnemyData.prefabKey has actual metadata AssignName=key; other instance fields have no EnemyDataMetaAttribute.
rules.alive: Entity.Init writes virtual get_maxHp(slot81) to m_hp. get_alive normal path requires StateMachine.isRunning && MathUtil.GT(hp,FP0). GT rhs adds MathUtil EN5 raw42950.
